PowerShell(gcloud auth list 2>&1; $t = gcloud auth print-access-token 2>$null; if \($t\) { try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/quimisol-4f159/databases/\(default\)/documents/almacenes?pageSize=1" -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $t"}; 'REST OK' } catch { "REST ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } else { 'no token' })

PowerShell($t = gcloud auth print-access-token; $b = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/quimisol-4f159/databases/\(default\)/documents"; $q = @{ structuredQuery = @{ from = @\(@{collectionId='pedidos'}\); where = @{ fieldFilter = @{ field=@{fieldPath='codigo'}; op='EQUAL'; value=@{stringValue='873331'} } } } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri "$b`:runQuery" -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $t"} -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $q; foreach \($x in $r\) { if \($x.document\) { $x.document.name; $f = $x.document.fields; foreach \($k in 'estado','repartidorUid','repartidor_uid','repartidorNombre','repartidor_nombre','fecha_envio','updatedAt','departamento','uid'\) { "{0} = {1}" -f $k, \($f.$k | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\) } } })
